To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

service ramp ups and downs can be seen as a dynamic system with multiple feedback loops and that the key to successful ramp up and down management is to manage the system and not just the parts of the system.
the nature of digital service ramp ups is different from ramp ups in production and that there are similarities between ramp downs in services and product recalls.
the key issues for ramp ups are the need to ramp the supply chain, biases in the organization, the need to launch in beta and the lack of transparency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the challenges of ramping up and ramping down digital services and the implications of these challenges for the management of innovation.
the challenges of scaling innovation in an established firm and how this is related to the dynamics of service ramp ups.
the challenges of taking innovation to market and the importance of understanding the processes and issues involved in ramp ups and ramping down.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ramp up of digital services can be very challenging and that the ramp down of digital services is even more challenging.
ramp ups and ramp down are a normal and expected part of the life cycle of digital services and that the issues identified are important to address.
ramp up problems are a result of the interplay between the various factors that affect ramp ups and ramp down.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
digital services are complex, and that the ramp up of such services is a complex process that requires the attention of senior management.
digital service ramp ups can be challenging and that the nature of digital services is such that the problems are visible and the need to ramp downs is inevitable.
ramping up digital services is difficult and that there is an inherent tension between innovation and scale in digital services.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the nature of digital service ramp ups and downs is very different from production and that there are a set of issues and challenges that need to be addressed in order to avoid problems and delays.
the ramp‐up of digital services is not a linear process and that there are many issues that need to be addressed.
service ramp ups and downs are not isolated events but are part of a continuous cycle that needs to be understood and managed.
